name: bugsmash
description: Instant Visual Feedback & Collaboration for Agencies, Product, Design & Marketing Teams

interface.longDescription: BugSmash is a collaborative review-feedback-approval platform designed for agencies, product teams, marketing teams to streamline the process of sharing any digital content and getting frictionless feedback & approval from clients and stakeholders. It's a review layer for the internet which allows anyone to comment directly on the content itself - be it live websites, dashboards, videos, PDFs, images, audios, and even mobile apps. Comments are pinned right where the context is! All feedback, progress, and approvals in one place—no more messy feedback loops, screenshots or scattered communication.
defaultPrompt: Summarize active feedback in my BugSmash projects.
Create a BugSmash review project for this website.
List my BugSmash projects and their latest versions.
